privacy.secNotCollectedTitle: 2. Data We Do NOT Collect & Non-Intrusion Guarantees
privacy.secNotCollectedText: To safeguard employee privacy, the platform expressly guarantees that:
privacy.secNotCollectedItem1Desc: No continuous or background GPS tracking is performed. Physical attendance is validated strictly via proximity to the classroom QR code projector.
privacy.secNotCollectedItem2Desc: The camera is only used to decode QR codes in client-side RAM. No photos or video recordings are ever captured, transmitted, or stored.
privacy.secNotCollectedItem3Desc: The platform never accesses microphones, contacts, call logs, or private device files.
privacy.secNotCollectedItem4Title: No Sensitive Health or Facial Biometrics:
privacy.secNotCollectedItem4Desc: No special categories of data under GDPR Art. 9 (health, fingerprint, or facial recognition biometrics) are processed.
privacy.secNotCollectedItem5Title: No Commercial Tracking or Third-Party Sale:
privacy.secNotCollectedItem5Desc: No off-platform user behavior tracking, profiling, or sharing with advertising networks.
privacy.secCookiesText: The platform does NOT use marketing, behavioral advertising, or third-party tracking cookies. It strictly uses essential local storage and session cookies:
privacy.secCookiesItem1Desc: Securely stores the JWT token to maintain authenticated sessions during navigation.
privacy.secCookiesItem2Desc: Saves chosen language (ES, EN, PT, FR, DE, PL, BG, RO) for persistent UI translation.
privacy.secCookiesItem3Desc: Maintains real-time connection for immediate operational and security notifications.
privacy.secCookiesLegalNote: * Under Article 22.2 of LSSI-CE and the European ePrivacy Directive, essential technical storage is exempt from prior consent as it is strictly necessary to deliver the requested service.
privacy.sec2Title: 4. Camera Usage, QR Codes, and TOTP Mechanism
privacy.title: Privacy and Data Protection Policy
privacy.sec1Text: The Smart Check-in system collects and processes only the data strictly necessary for training management, attendance tracking, and operational integrity:
privacy.sec1Item1Desc: First name, last name, username, corporate email, personal code (4-digit PIN), assigned company, and locator/site (workplace code).
privacy.sec1Item2Desc: Digitized handwritten signature trace (stored in Base64 format) required to certify attendance and completion of each training session.
privacy.sec1Item3Desc: Record of assigned sessions, attendances, stay durations, percentage attendance rates, and generated certificates.
privacy.sec1Item4Desc: Immutable traceability of logins, failed attempts, two-factor authentication (2FA) enablement, and source IP address.
privacy.sec2Text: Classroom interactions and check-ins utilize dynamic QR technology with the following safeguards:
privacy.sec2Item1Desc: Camera permission requested on mobile/desktop browsers is exclusively used for real-time client-side scanning of QR codes. At no point are images or videos recorded, transmitted, or stored.
privacy.sec2Item2Desc: QR codes refresh dynamically every 20 seconds using time-based TOTP algorithms, preventing spoofing, screenshots, or unauthorized remote check-ins.
privacy.sec2Item3Desc: In the event of camera technical issues, the platform provides a secure manual entry fallback using a one-time numeric passcode.
privacy.sec3Text: Enterprise-grade cybersecurity standards are implemented to protect your data:
privacy.sec3Item1Desc: Passwords are stored using the salted BCrypt one-way hash algorithm. 2FA (TOTP) secret keys are encrypted in the database using AES-256.
privacy.sec3Item2Desc: Automated account lockout after repeated failed attempts and dynamic SVG Captcha verification.
privacy.sec3Item3Desc: Signed JSON Web Tokens. Upon logout or account deletion, tokens are immediately added to a revocation blacklist.
privacy.sec3Item4Desc: All communications between your browser and the server are encrypted via TLS/HTTPS and secure WebSockets (WSS).
privacy.sec4Text: To ensure organizational transparency and information availability:
privacy.sec4Item1Desc: Critical system actions generate immutable audit logs (UTC timestamp, action, user, and IP) accessible only by authorized administrators.
privacy.sec4Item2Desc: Database backups and training attachments are synchronized to secure Microsoft OneDrive repositories via the official Microsoft Graph API (OAuth 2.0).
privacy.sec5Text: You have full control over your personal data under the European Union General Data Protection Regulation:
privacy.sec5Item1Desc: You can request and download a consolidated report containing all your personal data and training records at any time from your profile.
privacy.sec5Item2Desc: You have the right to update your credentials, 2FA setup, and personal details.
privacy.sec5Item3Title: Right to Erasure / To Be Forgotten:
privacy.sec5Item3Desc: You can request the permanent deletion of your account, instantly revoking your credentials and unlinking records subject to labor regulations.
privacy.sec5Item4Desc: You may consult corporate administration or the data protection officer regarding the scope of processing.
privacy.sec6Text: Data processing is based on compliance with legal obligations regarding working time tracking and workplace safety (Art. 6.1.c GDPR), performance of the employment relationship and training plans (Art. 6.1.b GDPR), and legitimate interest in ensuring the security of company systems and premises (Art. 6.1.f GDPR).
privacy.footerNotice: By using the Distribution Academy Smart Check-in System, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this Privacy Policy, consenting to the processing described herein.
privacy.sec3ItemPasskeyDesc: Phishing-resistant asymmetric authentication based on elliptic curve cryptography (secp256r1/ED25519) without passwords.
